<!-- pr-reviewer: 6e7b0d4321f37b04f032db98a90c695c41a9191f -->
Needs changes before merge.

The trial merge with upstream/main `404f8ec46a9728e800cacd124dff4977971a4069` is clean. The process declaration and decision record are present. No process version file changed.

Results, run locally on Linux with rustc and Cargo 1.100.0:

- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main --dry-run`: selects the xtask unit tests.
- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`: FAIL. The test build passed. Tests: 231 passed, 1 failed, 0 ignored.
- `cargo test -p xtask seed_tests::a_seeded_checkout_finds_a_build_script_dependency_fresh -- --exact --nocapture`: FAIL again when run alone.
- `cargo clippy -p xtask --all-targets -- -D warnings`: PASS.

Requested before merge:

1. `xtask/src/seed.rs:52` and `xtask/src/seed_tests.rs:102`: Support the artifact layout used by the current compiler. This machine stores dependency units under `target/debug/build/<package>/<hash>/fingerprint` and `out`. It has no `target/debug/deps` or `target/debug/.fingerprint`. Thus `units()` reports zero for built checkouts, and the seed does no work. The new test also fails when it reads the missing directory. Update the source scan, copy rules, local-package filter and test fixture for the supported layouts. Keep the freshness and local-source checks active. Run the quick gate again on Linux.

Exact failure:

```text
thread 'seed_tests::a_seeded_checkout_finds_a_build_script_dependency_fresh' panicked at xtask/src/seed_tests.rs:102:46:
units: Os { code: 2, kind: NotFound, message: "No such file or directory" }
```

Extra suites run: the failing seed test was run alone. The diff changes no testdata, importer code, UI, or goldens. No extra fixture or kernel suite applies. No heavy lane applies to these xtask changes.

Mutations: not run. This PR does not change posted G-code, geometry, collision checks, gouge checks, or stock simulation.

Note: the gate could not exercise a real seed here. It printed `target seed: no other checkout has built units; this worktree builds them`. The isolated fixture confirms that a successful build uses the other layout.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

Addressed: Support both Cargo artifact layouts.

The source scan now counts `build/<package>/<hash>/fingerprint` and legacy fingerprints. The copy stages each nested package before its rename. The filter excludes bare local package names. The fixture refreshes existing dependencies in either layout.

Pins:
- `both_artifact_layouts_copy_dependencies_and_exclude_local_packages` checks dependency copies and local exclusions in both layouts.
- `a_seeded_checkout_finds_a_build_script_dependency_fresh` keeps the freshness and local-source checks active.
- `a_unit_entry_of_a_local_package_is_never_copied` checks bare package names too.

Mutation checks: Restoring the old source makes the layout and freshness pins fail. Removing the bare-package filter makes the exclusion pin fail. Restoring the fix makes all five seed tests pass.

Linux rustc 1.100.0: `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main` passes with 262 tests and no failures. The gate seeded 457 entries from another checkout. `cargo clippy -p xtask --all-targets -- -D warnings` passes.

New head: 149e7a466f2c158ec0d88a91eec00bec1e0c3c25.

Please re-review this head.

<!-- pr-reviewer: 149e7a466f2c158ec0d88a91eec00bec1e0c3c25 -->
Ready for the maintainer to merge.

The trial merge with upstream/main `e3db8dfad4a67e253a4874012c8716561e21c1a2` is clean. GitHub reports MERGEABLE.

The earlier finding is resolved:

- The source scan finds legacy and nested Cargo fingerprints.
- The copy stages each nested package before its rename.
- The local filter excludes bare package names.
- The fixture keeps the freshness and local-source checks active in both layouts.

Results, run locally on Linux with rustc and Cargo 1.100.0:

- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main --dry-run`: selects the xtask unit tests after the local trial merge.
- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`: PASS. The test build and all 262 tests pass. No test failed or was ignored.
- All five `seed_tests` pass, including `a_seeded_checkout_finds_a_build_script_dependency_fresh` and `both_artifact_layouts_copy_dependencies_and_exclude_local_packages`.
- The gate copies 457 unit entries from another checkout. The source scan now works on this machine.
- `RUSTC_WRAPPER=sccache cargo clippy -p xtask --all-targets -- -D warnings`: PASS.

Extra suites run: none beyond the quick gate. The diff changes no fixture directory, testdata, importer code, UI, or golden. The extra fixture and kernel suites do not apply.

Mutations: not run. This PR does not change posted G-code, geometry, collision checks, gouge checks, or stock simulation. No goldens moved.

Requested before merge: none.

Notes:

- The process declaration and decision record are present. The PR does not change PROCESS_VERSION.
- The existing test `heavy_tests::heavy_steps_skip_only_binaries_without_ignored_tests` takes more than 60 seconds. It passes.
- Windows and macOS were not tested in this review.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

Merge: the coordinator merges head 149e7a466 on mkinney's pr-reviewer marker on this head (Ready) and the merge-ready label. It is a process PR (xtask); a PROCESS_VERSION bump follows. Note: the coordinator edited the PR body by mistake and then restored it to the same text.
